title: Coral and the Portrait
author: Ada Nystrom
blurb: Ansel Sandoval, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must learn the song's last verse without singing along before the last resident signs the papers.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
